import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.scatterplot(
    x='price_usd', 
    y='megapixels', 
    hue='sensor_type', 
    size='max_iso', 
    alpha=0.6, 
    data=df,
    legend='full'
)
plt.xscale('log')
plt.xlabel('Price (USD) [log scale]')
plt.ylabel('Megapixels')
plt.title('Camera Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type (Size = Max ISO)')
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
